summary: Re-test iteration_20: PRIMARY REGRESSION FIX VERIFIED. The onboarding tour now survives full 5-step navigation from /vendor/erp → /billing → /inventory → /reports → /vendor/erp. Hoisting <OnboardingTour/> into <TourProvider> at App root (wrapping <Routes>) resolved the unmount bug from iteration_19. Auto-open, tour-next x4, tour-finish, tour-close (X), and manual replay via tour-start-btn all work. sc.erp.tour.completed.v1 is correctly set on Done and X-close and correctly cleared by tour.restart(). Reload after Done/X does NOT re-auto-open. Smoke tests: CSV import shows '1 ready + 1 with errors' correctly, commit button is disabled when nothing selectable is left (all-invalid CSV). Owner PIN + password toggle still present on /vendor/erp/purchase-book. GST filing timeline renders 12 cells with DUE (1), OVERDUE (3), UPCOMING (8) — but 0 FILED for the current live date (Jul 2026, FY 2026-27) because sampleTimeline classifies anything older than 2 months as FILED and nothing in this FY is older than 2 months yet.

ui_bugs.issue: Polish item from iteration_19 was 'guarantee at least one DUE month so all 4 states are visible in preview'. DUE + OVERDUE are now guaranteed, BUT FILED can still be 0 when the FY started recently. On the live env (today = 2026-07-25, so year=2026 → FY 2026-27), Apr/May/Jun 2026 all land within monthsAgo<=2 → OVERDUE, leaving 0 FILED cells. The green FILED state is therefore not demonstrated on the current preview. Fix suggestion: force the two oldest past months to FILED regardless of monthsAgo, so preview always shows all 4 states.
Pre-existing DOM warning from iteration_19: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from Emergent x-source wrapper. Non-blocking.

csv_import_regression.commit_success_toast_captured: empty capture (sonner likely auto-dismissed before eval, but code path uses toast.warning/success with failed count)

gst_timeline.note: FILED=0 on current env date; DUE, OVERDUE, UPCOMING all present

critical_code_review_comments: TourProvider auto-open uses only 'popstate' — React-router internal navigate() calls do NOT fire popstate, so if a user lands on /vendor/erp via an in-app <Link/> (e.g. tapping the ERP 3.0 button in VendorNav) the tour will NOT auto-open until a full page load or browser back/forward. Consider driving the check off useLocation() inside TourProvider instead of window.location + popstate.
sampleTimeline still cannot guarantee a FILED cell early in the fiscal year (Apr–Jun). If the reviewer's ask was 'all 4 states visible in preview', pin the two oldest cells to FILED explicitly.

ProductCsvImport commit toast text was not captured in the automation (sonner auto-dismisses fast). Not a bug per se, but consider bumping the toast duration or writing a data-testid on the toast wrapper to make automated assertions reliable.
action_items: OPTIONAL LOW: Force sampleTimeline() in GstFilingTimeline.jsx to produce at least 1 FILED cell (e.g. mark the 2 oldest past months FILED regardless of monthsAgo threshold) so the green state is demonstrated even early in the FY.
OPTIONAL LOW: Replace window.location + popstate check in TourProvider with a useLocation() hook so in-app <Link/> navigation to /vendor/erp also triggers the tour auto-open on first visit.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the primary tour regression; 95% overall (GST FILED state cosmetic miss)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The onboarding-tour regression is fully fixed and validated end-to-end. Only cosmetic GST-timeline FILED count remains, which is a preview-only sample-data tweak. Other 3 features (CSV, PIN, GST panel presence) already stable from iteration_19 and still stable now.
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration_19 bug: <OnboardingTour/> was mounted inside ErpHub which unmounts on route change, wiping tour state. Iteration_20 fix moves the overlay + running/step state into <TourProvider> at the App root, above <Routes>. Overlay now renders as a sibling of the routed content, so it survives navigation. ErpHub reads useTour() and calls restart() from its 3-min-tour button. Confirmed by walking through all 5 steps twice (auto-open + manual replay), both times the tour-card and spotlight ring stayed mounted after every navigate().
